content.text: The latency spike aligns clearly with the pricing dependency slowdown, and no deploys/config changes occurred. The dependency is internal (owned by checkout-platform).

hypotheses.subject: io-pricing
hypotheses.summary: io-pricing (pricing.io-internal.svc), an internal dependency owned by checkout-platform, began responding slowly (~1500ms per call, saturating request pools) at the same minute p50/p95/p99 latency jumped roughly 30x on io-shop. No deploy or config change occurred on io-shop itself, and the failure mode is latency propagated through the basket-total call made during account page rendering.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-26T00:12:00Z WARN io-shop: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-7259-2-0/basket-total (126 of 200 requests)
2026-09-26T00:13:00Z WARN io-shop: slow upstream call - pricing.io-internal.svc took 1500ms for /v1/shoppers/shopper-28885-7-0/basket-total (200 of 200 requests)
io-pricing: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at pricing.io-internal.svc - Called while the account page renders

hypotheses.summary: No deployment or configuration change was recorded on io-shop in the hours before onset, so a bad-deployment or config-induced-failure inside io-shop itself is unlikely, but is listed as a fallback if the pricing correlation is coincidental.
